options.name: api_host
options.description: Specify the target host of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_HOST) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_otp
options.description: Specify the OTP. Uses the E(PROXMOX_OTP) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_password
options.description: Specify the password to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PASSWORD) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_port
options.description: Specify the target port of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PORT) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Time limit for requests towards the Proxmox VE API.

options.name: api_token_id
options.description: Specify the token ID. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_ID) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_token_secret
options.description: Specify the token secret. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_SECRET) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_user
options.description: Specify the user to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_USER) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: Path to a local certificate, which will be used to verify TLS connections. Ignored if O(validate_certs=false).

options.name: cleanup
options.description: If set remove partition table entries. Used with O(state=absent).

options.name: crush_device_class
options.description: Set the device class of the OSD in crush. Used with O(state=present).

options.name: db_dev
options.description: Block device name for block.db. Used with O(state=present).

options.name: db_dev_size
options.description: If a block.db is requested but the size is not given, will be automatically selected by bluestore_block_db_size from the ceph database (osd or global section) or config (osd or global section) in that order. If this is not available, it will be sized 10% of the size of the OSD device. Fails if the available size is not enough. Used with O(state=present).

options.name: deep
options.description: If set, instructs a deep scrub instead of a normal one. Used with O(state=scrub).

options.name: dev
options.description: Block device name. Required when O(state=present).

options.name: encrypted
options.description: Enables encryption of the OSD. Used with O(state=present).

options.name: node
options.description: The cluster node name.

options.name: osdid
options.description: Osd id. Required when O(state=absent), O(state=in), O(state=out), O(state=scrub), O(state=start), O(state=stop) or O-state=restart).

options.name: osds_per_device
options.description: OSD services per physical device. Used with O(state=present).

options.name: state
options.description: create, delete, in, out or scrub

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate the TLS certificates used for the connection to the Proxmox VE API. May be set through the environment variable E(PROXMOX_VALIDATE_CERTS).

options.name: wal_dev
options.description: Block device name for block.wal. Used with O(state=present).

options.name: wal_dev_size
options.description: If a block.wal is requested but the size is not given, will be automatically selected by bluestore_block_wal_size from the ceph database (osd or global section) or config (osd or global section) in that order. If this is not available, it will be sized 1% of the size of the OSD device. Fails if the available size is not enough. Used with O(state=present).
